** [[Soulwhisper, Elder Guardian]] ([[Gyala Hatchery (explorable area)]])
* [[Eye of the North]]
** [[Fozzy Yeoryios]] ([[Sacnoth Valley]])

== Notes ==
* This skill creates a [[Spirit of Preservation]].
* The spirit will prioritize the lowest health ally for healing.
* The healing is a passive effect; the spirit does not use any skills, so it cannot be [[interrupt]]ed; however, the healing will still trigger [[Scourge Healing]].
* Heroes only attempt to maintain this spirit in battle.
* The concise description neglects to mention that only allies in the area of the spirit will be healed.

==Trivia==
* The [[skill icon]] shows a spirit holding a glowing [[w:Ankh|ankh]], the Egyptian symbol of life.
* The functionality of this skill has changed since its introduction; see its [[/Skill history|skill revision history]] for details.
